method: Researched from official Atlassian support documentation (support.atlassian.com, atlassian.com/software/jira) covering navigation, UI surfaces, issue views, board customization, and project administration.

entry_screen.title: For you - personalized hub showing recent spaces, assigned work, starred items, recent boards/filters/dashboards

surfaces.title: Board
surfaces.description: Kanban or Scrum board view for managing work items across statuses
columns_optional: Custom status columns based on workflow configuration
view_settings_options: Work item display (sidebar vs centered dialog)
Field visibility (work type, key, epic, linked items, priority, assignee, card cover, due date, labels)

surfaces.title: Backlog
surfaces.description: Backlog view for prioritizing upcoming work (Scrum or Kanban)
columns_optional: Multiple sprint columns if multiple sprints exist
actions_menu: Backlog settings (Panels, Quick filters, Density, Field selection, Swimlanes, Card layout)
view_settings_options: Field selection (work type, key, version, epic, status, priority, assignee, due date)

surfaces.title: List
surfaces.description: Table/list view of work items with configurable columns, filterable and searchable
columns_optional: Any field available in Jira (up to 500 configurable)
tabs: Filter (if viewing a saved filter - overrides defaults)

surfaces.title: Work Item / Issue Detail View
surfaces.description: Detailed view of a single work item with all fields, comments, attachments, links, and actions
primary_actions: Add Content (with nested options: Attach, Link Issue, Comment, etc.)
actions_menu: More actions submenu with workflow-specific transitions and issue actions
workflow_actions: Issue actions (looped transitions that keep status same)

surfaces.title: Timeline
surfaces.description: Gantt chart view for visualizing and scheduling work items (available in business spaces only)
columns_optional: Any custom field can be added as inline-editable column
features: Scheduling bars with start and due dates
Blocking view to see which items may be blocked
Automatic roll-up of parent item dates based on children

surfaces.title: Dashboard
surfaces.description: Custom dashboard displaying gadgets, filters, and work metrics
features: Gadgets that pull through specific information via filters and data points
Shareable with viewer and editor permissions

surfaces.title: Project Navigation Tabs
surfaces.description: Horizontal tabs for switching between project views
optional_tabs: Any custom tabs added via apps
actions_menu: Tab management menu (reorder, rename, remove, set default)
constraints: Cannot remove the tab set as default

surfaces.title: Project Settings
surfaces.description: Administration and configuration pages for project settings (requires project admin or Administer Jira permission)
configuration_sections: Space Details (name, description, avatar, URL, lead)
Work Item Layout (how work items are displayed)
Schemes (notification, permission, workflow schemes - viewable by admins)

state_dependent_rules.unavailable_when: Space type is software space (team-managed or company-managed)

state_dependent_rules.available_when: User is space admin or has Administer Jira permission
state_dependent_rules.unavailable_when: User is a contributor without admin permissions

state_dependent_rules.available_when: User is project admin or has Administer Jira global permission
state_dependent_rules.unavailable_when: User is contributor without admin permissions

state_dependent_rules.available_when: User is the dashboard owner or has edit permission
User is Jira admin and within 60 days of deletion
state_dependent_rules.unavailable_when: User is not admin or 60 days has passed

state_dependent_rules.available_when: User has permission for the transition and the transition is configured in the workflow
state_dependent_rules.unavailable_when: User lacks permission or transition is not available for the current status

state_dependent_rules.available_when: Reports feature is enabled for the space (typically in business spaces)

search.trigger: Click search in top bar or press /
search.functionality: Find work items, spaces, boards, queues, filters, and people with auto-suggest

create.functionality: Create new work item across spaces

gaps: Could not establish the exact default column names for board views - different board configurations (Scrum vs Kanban, company-managed vs team-managed) likely have different default column sets. Documented common example columns but these are inferred.
Could not establish the complete list of gadgets/widgets available for dashboards - documentation mentions they exist but does not enumerate them.
Could not establish whether the Reports tab is always available or conditional - whether it requires a specific license or feature flag is unclear from documentation.
Could not establish the precise structure and field definitions of the custom field limit - documentation mentions 500 column limit in list view but details on field type restrictions are unclear.
Could not establish the exact format and capabilities of the inline editing in Timeline view - which field types are inline-editable is not specified.
Could not establish whether 'Quick Filters' are a built-in feature or require configuration - the documentation references them as available but does not clarify their creation process.
Could not establish the full list of 'Quick add' buttons that appear in the Add Content menu - documentation indicates they were reorganized in July 2024 but the current complete list is not sourced.
Could not establish complete list of issue actions (looped transitions) - workflow-specific and varies by configuration, so a generic list could not be sourced.
Could not establish detailed project settings sidebar structure beyond listed sections - additional tabs from apps and integrations are possible but not enumerated.
